risks: only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series carries a strong long-run trend. Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (1 points, ~1% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.361), which favours a weighted combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'best_single THETA' (an agent proposal) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score -0.0305. Series context: trend strength 0.9912 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.361); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.716.
